beats.speaker: Zip
beats.text: There are three books in here. Drafted. Accepted. Imposed. Wanna guess which one's the heaviest?

beats.speaker: Nell Mercer
beats.action: flips to the first page of the imposed register
beats.text: Every line has my name. None has my handwriting.

beats.speaker: Raven
beats.text: That's what the index doesn't show. Our system counted possible versions of you, but never the person standing in front of it.

beats.speaker: Erin
beats.action: runs an independent read-only continuity check
beats.text: Sixty-four signatures from projected futures. Zero from present-day Nell. The contract's consent field is empty.

beats.speaker: Lari
beats.action: tests the loophole with a deliberately polished explanation
beats.text: In our defense, the contract requires unanimous approval. We were merely very generous about who qualified as you.

beats.speaker: Nell Mercer
beats.text: Then add a column. CURRENT. And write this down: I count.

beats.speaker: Zip
beats.action: slides a loose brass tab into the empty register slot
beats.text: Bigfixer repair number one: a place for the actual person. Amazing what you can fix with a tab.

beats.speaker: Raven
beats.text: That one correction may invalidate six thousand years of policy.

beats.speaker: Erin
beats.text: Then we had better keep the original records.
